english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a sedan or saloon car’s luggage compartment.

exampleSentences.english: Can you check whether there’s an umbrella in the boot for me?
exampleSentences.traditional: 你幫我睇吓尾箱有冇把遮。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 haa5 mei5 soeng1 jau5 mou5 baa2 ze1
